contract.input: The caller must supply the two already-selected strongest supported proposals. This kernel neither searches memory nor manufactures support.
contract.identity: Opaque complete-path keys owned by the caller, never context labels or recyclable beam slots. Unknown is None; numeric key zero remains a known key.
contract.stay: Must refer to the supplied known parent; an unknown parent cannot claim a discarded identity as stay.
contract.duplicates: Keep the first positive role in stay/retrieved/new order with its own raw score; no summation and no refill from a weaker candidate. Distinct complete-path keys stay distinct.
contract.missing: Known-parent admitted transition priors remain available without new observation. An unknown parent admits no known alternative without observed support. Complete observation-score suppression remains the normalizer contract.
contract.normalization: Normalize admitted positive known raw scores in probability space, give them exp(-dt/120) total mass, and reserve -expm1(-dt/120) for unknown. With no known alternative, unknown has mass one. Unknown remains an explicit slot at dt=0.
contract.numerics: Finite nonnegative raw scores and finite nonnegative dt required even for masked proposals. Log probabilities use max-scaled sum; no heap allocation or mutable state.
contract.capacity: Four fixed slots per parent. Seven known parents and one unknown parent produce at most 31 occupied slots; the canonical conservative shared capacity remains 32.

scope: all support masks and known/unknown parents with/without observation
same-path duplicate roles, zero scores, zero/tiny/long dt, extreme/subnormal finite scores
invalid score, clock and stay rejection before masking
2/8/32/60-second gaps at 1/2/1000 subdivisions; support-based unknown recovery
31 shared extensions and 8 local groups through the real joint normalizer, with nonzero synthetic scores and full probability-space enumeration
explicit unknown versus 16 pruned identities, stable ties, identity binding and forbidden unknown-parent stay

limits: Shared proposal kernel is under the existing test-only joint module; no normal acoustic observer or ordinary action table uses it yet.
Real strongest-candidate selection, complete-path state ownership/lifetime, bus/epoch/support provenance and once-per-interval delivery remain caller work.
Complete ordered joint feature registration, real conditional scores, all heads and ordinary candidate reweighting remain incomplete.
No claim of real-time resource acceptance, retention/readmission on real audio, calibration, audibility or author adoption.
